description: Architecture milestone benchmark matrix. Comparison rows are equivalent real builds on both sides. Failing rows are required comparisons that are not implemented yet.

phases.title: Dynamic derivation primitive probes
phases.notes: Runs committed Nix primitive probes, including feature flags, builtins.outputOf availability, and nix derivation show/add round-trips for penance and haskell.nix benchmark derivations.

phases.title: Commit-time lock generation
phases.notes: Runs penance-lock --check against the committed benchmark fixture lock plus the StateVar external-dependency lock fixture, asserts deterministic bytes, stale-lock rejection, hackage sdist metadata, and ghc-boot metadata, then compares with the real haskell.nix generated plan output.

phases.title: Static unit path on simple library fixture
phases.notes: The penance target is the lock-built simple-lib component from penanceProject: Nix reads schema-1 strata.lock, builds a content-addressed library with split ABI-stub iface and real object/archive outputs, and compares it with the haskell.nix simple library build.

phases.title: Static unit path on module-heavy benchmark
phases.notes: The penance target is the lock-built benchmark executable from penanceProject: Nix reads schema-1 strata.lock, compiles the executable against dbIface, links it against dbFull, and smoke-tests the generated output, compared with the haskell.nix executable build.

phases.title: Module-granular path on Template Haskell benchmark
phases.notes: The penance target runs a content-addressed recursive-Nix planner that emits one dynamic derivation per module plus a final assemble derivation; module interfaces are body-erased ABI stubs while object outputs compile real source. Exact rebuild-cutoff assertions are tracked by the M4 rebuild-scenarios rows.

phases.title: First-class Backpack instantiation graph
phases.notes: Real Cabal Backpack fixture with one indefinite library, two implementation libraries, and two executable instantiations compared with the haskell.nix executable build.

phases.title: aarch64-linux target build
phases.notes: Builds aarch64-linux ELF probes: penance emits a fixed minimal target ELF in a raw derivation, while the haskell.nix baseline uses the overlay cross stdenv. Haskell project cross parity is covered by HN-project-cross.

phases.title: Multi-System Closure bundle
phases.notes: Creates closureInfo-backed bundle artifacts and manifests for the penance and haskell.nix benchmark executable closures.

phases.title: Device deploy and hot-swap loop
phases.notes: Writes each benchmark executable closure manifest into a device-cache directory and atomically exposes the managed service executable through a run-directory hot-swap symlink.
